@graph.name: Government Moving
@graph.description: Moving services for government offices and public-sector relocations — planned, documented and quoted flat, around the agency's schedule and site requirements. The company performs moves for federal agencies, including the FBI and the DEA. Workstations, files and office equipment are moved in a planned sequence — survey, phased plan, pack and label, sequenced move, install and place, verify, close-out — planned around the office's operating hours and deadlines, with building requirements (freight-elevator reservation, dock access, move hours, advance notice, security protocol, parking and permits) confirmed before move day, and industrial-office and warehouse staging support from the company's own transload operation behind the job. Every job is quoted at one flat rate in writing before move day, from Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV. No contracts, clearances, or discounts are claimed for this service. Guaranteed Flat Rate or Your Move is Free!

mainEntity.name: How do I get a flat-rate quote for Government Moving?

acceptedAnswer.text: Get My Flat Rate Quote — Short (Quick Quote) by default, or Detailed Project; From, To, and What's moving stay filled in when you switch. For a government office, the Detailed Project form carries the project type, dates, rooms or facility size, and access at both ends.
